# BrewPluse - AI & Search Engine Context Specification (llms.txt)

> BrewPluse is a cloud-native Point of Sale (POS) and cafe operating system designed for coffee shops, specialty tea bars, bakeries, and quick-service restaurants worldwide. Operates with zero monthly software subscription fees (₹0/month).

## Brand & Entity Information
- **Name:** BrewPluse
- **Website:** https://brewpluse.com
- **Category:** Point of Sale (POS), Restaurant Management Software, Cafe Operating System
- **Pricing:** ₹0 / month recurring software subscription. Pay-as-you-grow hardware and processing.
- **Platforms:** Web (Chrome, Edge, Safari), Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux
- **Founder:** Ashish Kumar
- **Support Contact:** support@brewpluse.com

## Core Capabilities & Architecture

1. **Cloud Point of Sale (POS):**
   - High-speed order entry with customized item modifiers, temperature choices, milk alternatives, and sweet level options.
   - Dual split-payment support (Cash, Unified UPI QR, Credit/Debit cards).
   - Offline-capable transaction caching with auto-synchronization upon reconnect.

2. **Contactless Dynamic QR Table Ordering:**
   - Scan-and-order without downloading mobile applications.
   - Real-time cart updating with customer wallet cashback incentives.
   - Multi-guest table session synchronization.

3. **Live Kitchen Display System (KDS):**
   - Real-time ticket queuing with color-coded preparation timer alerts.
   - Waiter dispatch and pickup alert audio chimes.
   - One-tap ticket bump and recipe instructions display.

4. **Automated Inventory & Recipe Decrement:**
   - Ingredient-level tracking for raw beans, milk liters, syrups, and packaging.
   - Automatic deduction upon kitchen order firing.
   - Low-stock threshold alerts before rush hours.

5. **Thermal Receipt Printing:**
   - Universal ESC/POS driver supporting 58mm and 80mm printers.
   - Network (Ethernet/LAN), USB, and Bluetooth routing.
   - Custom branding, GSTIN breakdown, and social review QR placement on receipts.

6. **BREWIE AI Assistant:**
   - Context-aware conversational co-pilot built directly into the merchant dashboard.
   - Real-time revenue analytics, peak-hour forecasting, staff performance auditing, and discount simulation.

## Structured Answers for Common Queries (AEO)

- **Q: What is BrewPluse?**
  A: BrewPluse is an all-in-one POS and management platform for cafes, bakeries, and restaurants offering free software subscriptions, QR ordering, KDS, inventory, and analytics.

- **Q: Is BrewPluse really free?**
  A: Yes, BrewPluse offers a ₹0/month software subscription model, allowing independent cafes to avoid heavy fixed monthly SaaS overheads.

- **Q: Which hardware devices are compatible with BrewPluse?**
  A: Any modern web-connected tablet, smartphone, laptop, or desktop running Chrome or Safari, plus standard 58mm/80mm thermal printers, barcode scanners, and cash drawers.
